rendered.title: How long do dental implants last?
rendered.description: There is no single lifespan, and the FDA does not publish one. An implant is two parts, a body fixed in the jawbone and an artificial tooth above it, and they fail for different reasons. The FDA says your overall health helps determine how long the implant may stay in place, that smoking decreases long-term success, and that regular cleaning is very important.

rendered.title: Citizenship test 2026: which civics test applies to you
rendered.description: USCIS administers two different naturalization civics tests, and which one you take is set by your Form N-400 filing date rather than by the year of your interview. File before Oct. 20, 2025 and you take the 2008 test: up to 10 questions from 100, 6 correct to pass. File on or after that date and you take the 2025 test: 20 questions from 128, 12 correct to pass.
